facts.text: Cairo office stock of about 1.0 million m2 (Knight Frank definition), with a further 818,000 m2 in the pipeline to 2029, equal to +82% of stock
facts.src: Knight Frank, Cairo office review H2 2025, via Arabian Business (July 2026)

facts.text: New Cairo holds 73% of current and future Cairo office stock; Grade A occupancy is about 90%
Office vacancy averaged about 9% and was stable in Q1 2026; over 100,000 m2 of Grade A and B space was delivered in the quarter
Grade A business-park rent in New Cairo of USD 348/m2/yr (market average USD 325); EGP rents up about 20% y/y after the pound's fall
facts.src: Knight Frank Q2 2026, via Enterprise (8 July 2026)

facts.text: Cairo retail stock above 3.3 million m2 after about 89,000 m2 delivered in Q1 2026, mostly small malls in New Cairo and Giza; about 331,300 m2 more due by end 2026
Mostakbal City covers about 11,000 feddans, with a planned population of about 1 million; master developer is the state-linked Mostakbal for Urban Development (MIDAR)
Connected by the Regional (Middle) Ring Road and the East Cairo monorail corridor to Shorouk, Obour, Badr and the New Administrative Capital
Comparable commercial schemes are under way: Hassan Allam's HAPTOWN (offices G+1 to G+4, retail, healthcare) in Mostakbal City
Office asking prices in Mostakbal City listings: about EGP 106,000 to 120,000 per m2
facts.src: Property Finder listings, Sumou Boulevard and Zizinia (2026)

facts.text: Retail unit asking prices in New Cairo (Fifth Settlement) listings range from about EGP 139,000 to 325,000 per m2; individual listings, not an index
New Cairo secondary-market sale prices rose 3.1% y/y in Q1 2026, while asking rents rose 10.0%
Broker estimates put 2026 price growth at 10 to 15% in New Cairo and 12 to 16% in Mostakbal City (blog estimate, not an index)
facts.src: Sands of Wealth, drawing on Aqarmap data (2026)

facts.text: CBE overnight deposit rate 19.00%, unchanged at the September 2026 meeting; urban headline inflation 14.5% in August 2026
facts.src: CBE via Bnok24; CAPMAS via Ahram Online

facts.text: Top 10 developers' sales reached EGP 670 bn in H1 2026 against EGP 651 bn in H1 2025 (+2.9%), with units sold down 5% y/y
Prime Minister Decree 2184 of 2022 requires developers on state-allocated land to hold a separate project bank account and to follow approved timelines before announcing sales
Typical off-plan payment plans run 8 to 12 years with 1.5% to 10% down payments
